name: task-manager
description: Gestor de tareas: API REST con Express y SQLite, y frontend con React. Todo en TypeScript.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
